software_rules.name: ProfileContentIdentity
software_rules.source_business_rule: The profile must be deterministic and content-bound.

software_rules.name: KnownSemanticVocabularyOnly
software_rules.source_business_rule: Unknown object types, extension namespaces and relation endpoints cannot silently change meaning.
software_rules.software_rule: all identifiers belong to the frozen core or declared extension profile

software_rules.name: ReadOnlyDescriptorBoundary
software_rules.source_business_rule: An ontology descriptor must not be mistaken for an object resolver, State, Authority or execution permission.
software_rules.software_rule: descriptor accepts semantic/source/context hashes only and rejects state authority commit execution and registry fields

software_rules.name: CompatibilityNeverMigrates
software_rules.source_business_rule: A compatibility result must not cause object migration or write a registry.
software_rules.software_rule: compare_profiles returns only a declared outcome
